title: Self-assessment: keeping a clear and safe record
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Original practical exercise with fictional people; never imported, published or shown to learners.
gaps: No published exercise may exist until the review phase: this is a specification only.
The wording, answers and explanations are the author's reading of the cited sources and have had no clinical or educational review.
The exercise has not been tested with learners, and its Arabic version has not been written.
This is a self-reflection tool, not an assessment: no scores, no verification, no certificate.
permissions: Cited sources are paraphrased only; see the licensing register for each source's reproduction status.
objectives: Rate your own record-keeping habits honestly.

sources.use: Open RN Nursing Fundamentals 2.5: documentation principles and error correction

setup: A personal list; the learner rates themselves, and the ratings stay on their device.

items.text: I record the date, time and my signature on every entry.
I write what I saw, heard and did, not opinions.
I never record something as done before it is done.
I correct mistakes openly and never erase.
I avoid abbreviations that are not on my employer's list.
When I write a late entry, I label it clearly and state both the time of the event and the time I am writing it.
I write specific findings rather than vague summaries like 'seems fine' or 'no change'.
